title: Install the modpack
description: Pick a client and the components. The manager never touches other mods without your confirmation.
profileLoaded: The selection is loaded from the profile

source.release: Version {version} is downloaded from the server; every package is checked against its checksum
source.offline: No connection — the modpack cannot be installed right now, try again later
source.unavailable: No modpack release supports this client version yet

otherModsDescription: Mods by other authors stay in place. Tick what you want removed.
otherModsEmpty: No other mods in this client
reviewReinstall: The modpack is already installed: it is replaced with this selection, and disabled components ({count}) stay disabled
confirmRemoveDescription: Exactly the ticked files and folders are removed. This cannot be undone.
noCatalog: The component catalogue has not been downloaded from the server yet
clientUnsupported: The modpack cannot be installed into this client — choose Lesta's Mir Tankov at a supported version

dependencies.title: Required libraries
dependencies.description: Free third-party mods the selected components need. They are downloaded from their authors' official releases and checked against a pinned checksum; the licence is kept with the install. A copy you installed yourself stays yours and is never replaced or removed. An optional library can be unticked: the components work without it and lose only the convenience it adds.
dependencies.author: Author:

installingHint: Downloading the packages, checking their checksums and putting the files in place. Do not start the game until the install finishes.

partial.other_mods: Some of the other mods could not be removed — they are still in the game folder
partial.dependencies: The libraries some components need were not installed — those components may not load
